card.name: The word time after date and
card.fires_on: The word "time" (sometimes "date") right after "date and", "day and" or "date," in instructions to record when something was done, opened, inserted or calibrated.

modes.description: "time" or "date" appears as an item in a comma list of recorded details.
modes.example: Record the date,<< time>>, total activity, volume, and concentration
